'''Merrilet Gorron''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] who operated around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Gorron was a known associate of [[Ulicx Vinaq]].
